description: Shapes how each note of a melody is reached rather than which note it is — picked fresh, slid into, hammered, pedalled or left out — and passes the melody on with that applied

params.text: Picks the first of the two playing traditions the morph knob blends between, from ten ordered by how much sliding they use
Picks the second of the two playing traditions the morph knob blends between, from the same ten
Blends between the two chosen traditions, from the first fully anticlockwise to the second fully clockwise
Leans the decision toward or away from sliding, -3 to 3, on top of whatever the traditions say

inputs.text: The melody's pitch as a volt per octave, one note at a time
A rise starts a note and a fall ends it
A rise forces the next note to be struck fresh rather than slid into
Sets how hard each note is struck, 0-10V, which is passed on and also weighs on the decision
Sets the beat strength that weighs on the decision, and gives the glide a deadline to arrive by
A rise marks the start of a phrase, which weighs on the decision
A rise clears the run of past decisions so the next note starts a fresh phrase
Sets the root the scale-degree tests are measured against, a volt per octave
Blends between the two traditions, ±5V added to the morph knob
Leans the decision toward or away from sliding, ±5V added to the bias knob

outputs.text: The melody with the glide and any vibrato applied, ready for a voice's pitch input
A trigger only on a note that is struck fresh, so a note slid into does not retrigger the voice
A gate that stays high across a slide rather than dropping between the two notes
The velocity of the current note, passed on from the velocity input
A 0-10V rise while a glide is in flight, for driving whatever the voice does during a slide
The pitch, moving only when the decision is a pedalled note, for a voice that treats pedalling separately

notes: the module makes no sound: it takes a melody in and puts the same melody out with the playing decisions applied, so its outputs go to a voice's pitch, gate and velocity inputs
a decision that is physically impossible is refused whatever the knobs say: a slide that cannot reach the next note inside the time the clock allows is never chosen
the ten traditions are ordered by how much sliding they use, so the morph knob moves smoothly across them; the underlying figures are deliberately not shown anywhere
menu: Temperature — hedging, not commitment — a slider from 0.05 to 4 setting how firmly a decision is made; raising it turns committed slides into hedged ones and into rests
Re-seed — draws a fresh random seed, so the same melody is played with a different set of decisions
